description: Free, no API key. Score a live store listing from 0 to 100 using its public title, description and number of localizations, with tips per part. On the App Store the subtitle and keyword field are not public, so they are returned as N/A and left out of the score. This is a listing-quality heuristic, not a store ranking and not a download prediction.

platform.description: Store to read. Defaults to ios for a numeric id, android otherwise.

store_id.description: App Store numeric id or Google Play package name (from find_app).

name: listing_score
